title: Separate runtime maintenance, release update, migration, and package install operation boundaries
description: AstrBot dashboard update routes combine release checks, project/dashboard update, pip install, and DB migration triggering. Rust already has config/storage migration and plugin dependency planning, but no operation boundary for user-triggered maintenance tasks. Define this before dashboard update/migration/install APIs grow inside web handlers, runtime config code, or plugin loader dependencies.

files.change: Model check/update operations, release metadata, and dashboard update descriptors outside HTTP routes.
Coordinate config/storage migration prechecks and execution without coupling web handlers to DB migration internals.
Represent user-triggered operation status, progress, and error reporting for dashboard use.
Keep update/migration/package-install HTTP endpoints delegating to typed maintenance services.

criteria: Dashboard update/migration routes do not call storage migration or package install internals directly.
Maintenance operations expose typed progress/results usable by observability and management APIs.
Plugin dependency installation remains separate from global runtime maintenance operations.
convergence.verification_command: cargo test -p astrbot-runtime && cargo test -p astrbot-storage && cargo test -p astrbot-web && cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings
